title: Who's the Bot?
description: A reverse Turing test. Everyone answers a funny prompt on their phone while AI players secretly answer too. Vote the funniest, then catch the bot. Final round flips it: find the one human hiding among the bots.
prompt: Hand-written house game: reverse Turing test with AI players (bot_answer), Find the Bot rounds then a Find the Human final.
hook: A noir party where one of you is secretly a machine.
